pitfalls.title: stale_lockfile_drift
pitfalls.description: Package manifest changes can drift from tracked lockfiles and break frozen-lockfile or deployment paths.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Install or deploy failures complaining that lockfiles are out of date with package manifests.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Treat tracked lockfiles as source truth and resynchronize every affected workspace when dependency changes land.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run continuity and lockfile-aware verification after dependency edits.

pitfalls.title: diagnostics_serialization_crash
pitfalls.description: Diagnostics formatting can crash the error handler if stringify results are treated as guaranteed strings.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Routes return empty or opaque 500 responses because the logging path threw while handling the original error.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Server error-handling and diagnostics serialization must never throw.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Review error-path logging changes for unsafe stringify or string-method calls.

pitfalls.title: request_json_parse_falls_into_500
pitfalls.description: Malformed request bodies can throw before validation and fall through to generic 500 handling.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Bad client payloads look like server failures instead of explicit malformed-body 400s.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Wrap request.json() in try/catch before schema validation in POST routes.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Search POST routes for inline safeParse(await request.json()) patterns.

pitfalls.title: consumed_response_stream_fallback
pitfalls.description: Calling response.json() before response.text() consumes the stream and hides fallback diagnostics.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Fallback parse branches receive empty text after the first parse attempt.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Read response.text() first, then parse JSON from the captured text if needed.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Search for response.json() fallback patterns followed by response.text().

pitfalls.title: generated_artifact_cleanup_miss
pitfalls.description: Verification runs can leave build, audit, or emulator outputs behind and pollute continuity signoff.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Continuity fails or dirty-tree noise appears after otherwise passing verification.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Clean generated artifacts before final signoff.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run the generated-artifact check before completion.

pitfalls.title: sidecar_truth_confusion
pitfalls.description: Fallback, RTDB, or Data Connect sidecars can be mistaken for canonical serving truth when they are not current in-repo readers.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Sidecar/export layers are treated as if they are the main product-serving analytics source.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Do not represent fallback or derived data as stronger truth than source truth.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Check whether the candidate storage layer has a verified in-repo reader before treating it as canonical.

pitfalls.title: route_runtime_stale_vs_unseen_confusion
pitfalls.description: Stale route samples and never-observed route samples have different meanings and should not be collapsed together.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Debug summaries overstate failures because stale, unseen, and healthy states are not separated.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Use shared route-runtime freshness and coverage helpers.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Check route-runtime summaries for ad hoc last-result logic instead of shared helpers.

pitfalls.title: legacy_queue_adapter_usage
pitfalls.description: Next App Route cron endpoints are now compatibility adapters only and should not remain the active queue scheduler lane.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Legacy adapter warnings accumulate even though Firebase scheduler is supposed to be canonical.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Use Firebase Functions scheduler as the canonical queue runtime and treat route cron endpoints as manual adapters only.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run scheduler freshness and warning-budget checks; any legacy adapter warning is blocking.

pitfalls.title: queue_activation_missing_notification_outcome
pitfalls.description: Every canonical activation attempt must persist a dispatch outcome; silent notification attempts are no longer acceptable truth.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Drops activate but no persisted `notification_dispatch_outcomes` row exists for the activation key.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Persist an explicit outcome for success, duplicate, skipped, or failed dispatch states.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run the queue runtime continuity check and inspect notification outcome rows for missing activation keys.

pitfalls.title: stale_queue_scheduler_heartbeat
pitfalls.description: Queue lifecycle and activation jobs can silently stop running even while the rest of the app appears healthy.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Drops remain scheduled/expired incorrectly because `queue_job_heartbeats` are stale or failed.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Treat heartbeat freshness as a blocking runtime continuity lane.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run `npm run check:scheduler:freshness` and fail when queue heartbeats are missing, stale, or failed.

pitfalls.title: unchecked_response_ok_ui_hydration
pitfalls.description: Client module hydration that parses bodies without response.ok guards can downgrade route failures into misleading empty states.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: UI renders as empty or stale even though the backing route failed.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Parse route responses through a helper that validates response.ok before hydrating UI state.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Search for response.json() before a response.ok branch in client fetch flows.

pitfalls.title: creator_booking_timezone_drift
pitfalls.description: Booking availability validation can drift when creator windows are stored in creator-local time but validated in UTC.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Valid creator-local booking slots are rejected or off by hours for non-UTC creators.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Validate booking slots against the stored availabilityTimezone before applying conflict logic.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Check booking validation for getUTC* calls against creator availability windows.

pitfalls.title: silent_ui_fallback_masking_failure
pitfalls.description: Fallback UI data should not hide the fact that a critical module failed to hydrate.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Users see partial content without any warning that a creator/admin module is degraded.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Fallbacks must render explicit warning state and emit diagnostics.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Inspect async-heavy UI modules for fallback data with no warning shell.

pitfalls.title: frontend_parallel_state_wrapper_sprawl
pitfalls.description: Frontend parity and hydration fixes can add another wrapper or hook even when an existing surface state, telemetry, or role resolver already owns the behavior.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Components carry repeated loading/error state, direct telemetry payloads, local role checks, or viewport logic that drifts from canonical hooks and contracts.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Route components through canonical hooks/resolvers, keep UI components thin, and end every frontend task by searching duplicate state/hook/telemetry logic.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run check:frontend-component-consolidation and inspect direct trackEvent, localStorage/sessionStorage, innerWidth, and duplicated useState/useEffect clusters.

pitfalls.title: viewer_watch_capture_continuity_drift
pitfalls.description: Viewer watch sessions can degrade silently when flush outcomes, close-path sync, or replay recovery are not surfaced into continuity checks.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Watch-time analytics look sparse or inconsistent even though viewer usage continues.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Persist capture-quality metadata on canonical watch sessions and run the analytics continuity lane for viewer capture work.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Check close-missing, flush-degraded, and degraded-rate counts in canonical watch session docs.

pitfalls.title: config_deployment_readiness_confusion
pitfalls.description: Config, deployment, environment, CI, package-script, middleware, Firebase rules, and dependency changes can be mistaken for ordinary source-only cleanup.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: A pass claims readiness after local tests while env contracts, release notes, security/rules validation, PR hygiene, rollback status, current-head score artifacts, or operator evidence remain stale.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Do not treat passing source tests as deployment readiness. Do not add package scripts, validators, or generated artifacts without checking for existing scripts that already own the same lane. Every config or deployment change must declare owner, environment, expected command, safety class, cost class, and rollback behavior. Never touch payment runtime, GumDrop math, provider callbacks, Firebase/security rules, middleware, or deployment configs casually. Before editing config, deployment, env, CI, package scripts, middleware, Firebase rules, or dependency tooling, classify the lane and read existing policy. Config and deployment changes are release-risk changes. Dependency PRs are not cleanup. Generated artifacts must be compact by default.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run check:config-env-contract, check:security-rules-inventory, check:package-script-consolidation, check:ci-release-discipline, check:security-header-route-config, check:dependency-toolchain-policy, and check:config-infra-memory-writeback before release closeout.

pitfalls.title: duplicate_type_schema_contract_drift
pitfalls.description: Shared entities, DTOs, schemas, generated reports, and validator shapes can drift when a pass adds another local interface instead of importing a canonical owner.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Codex reads one user, creator, wallet, GumDrop, event envelope, debug finding, evidence, or analytics metric shape and writes another incompatible one.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Before adding a new interface, DTO, schema, or contract, search for an existing canonical type. Do not create another shape for the same concept unless replacing the old one and updating imports. Every shared domain object must have one canonical owner. User, creator, GumDrop, wallet, entitlement, event envelope, debug finding, release evidence, and analytics metric shapes should not be redefined inside random components, routes, tests, or validators. Generated report schemas must be compact and typed through canonical contracts. Do not create massive generated JSON shapes that drift from source types. If a validator needs a shape, import or derive the canonical type instead of copy-pasting a near-duplicate test-only interface. End every type/schema pass by searching for duplicate interface/type names, local DTOs, stale aliases, and unsafe_unknown schema drift.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run check:type-schema-inventory, check:canonical-type-owner-map, check:schema-validation-ownership, check:generated-report-schema-contract, check:type-schema-memory-writeback, and check:type-schema-gut-consolidation.
